scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p api/tsconfig.json && tsc -p api/tsconfig.jest.json && uv run -q --project sdks/python --frozen pyright
scripts.lint: bun fmt --check && biome lint . && uv run -q --project sdks/python --frozen ruff check sdks/python scenarios/runners/python && uv run -q --project sdks/python --frozen ruff format --check sdks/python scenarios/runners/python
scripts.format: bun fmt && biome lint --write . && uv run -q --project sdks/python --frozen ruff check --fix sdks/python scenarios/runners/python && uv run -q --project sdks/python --frozen ruff format sdks/python scenarios/runners/python
scripts.test: vitest run --project unit && uv run -q --project sdks/python --frozen pytest -q sdks/python/tests
scripts.check:deps: depcruise server codegen sdks/typescript integrations examples scenarios scripts test --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs
